name: 28716 · Canton, NC
findings: ZIP 28716 (Canton) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28716 (Canton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28716 (Canton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
